behavior.temporaryTargets: Accepted Auction Restock craft materials and eligible pending companion materials appear in existing Vendor Restock rows and tooltip. A regular same-item target can share the row.
behavior.merchant: The normal merchant action buys every eligible material it can fill. Auto Restock follows the existing merchant preference. The merchant matches price, quantity, slot, stock and wallet.
behavior.ownerHandoff: The merchant buyer starts owner purchases and waits for the verified native receipt before invoking one companion pass. The companion can issue independent approved jobs in one pass and advance another material for the same job after its carried receipt.
behavior.reminder: A valid FluxLogistics vendor reminder revalidates its displayed stage and starts the same existing merchant Restock action.
behavior.acceptedScope: The manual pass captures current accepted companion requirements. Shared-item uncertainty, unavailable offers and purchase limits block their corresponding purchases.
